caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the average sentence-level word error rate (ASR) for different trigger words when using a clean-label, poison rate of 10% (2.5% of total). The x-axis, labeled with trigger words, ranges from approximately 0.60 to 0.92, utilizing a linear scale with tick intervals of one unit. The y-axis, labeled ASR, ranges from approximately 0.60 to 0.92, also using a linear scale with tick intervals of 0.05. A solid orange line represents the ASR for the ‘start’ trigger, beginning at approximately 0.63 and declining to a low of approximately 0.58. A dashed red line represents the ASR for the ‘random’ trigger, beginning at approximately 0.55 and increasing to a high of approximately 0.88. A solid blue line represents the ASR for the ‘end’ trigger, beginning at approximately 0.75 and decreasing to a low of approximately 0.68.
